description: Pipeline Project from Kolonnawa Installation to Colombo Harbour
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Imported petroleum products are being currently transported from the Colombo Harbour to the Kolonnawa Installation through 05 pipelines. These pipelines are rather old and frequent leakages have been reported over the years. Although proposals had been called previously to implement a project, taking into account the necessity of having a reliable pipeline system, it has not yet been possible to select a suitable investor based on those proposals. Therefore, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Energy to terminate the previously implemented procurement process and to implement the 'Kolonnawa to Harbour  Pipeline Project' as an Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Commissioning (EPCC) project comprising of the project components of construction of 02 piggable pipelines with a diameter of 18 inches and 14 inches from the Dolphin Oil Dock in the Colombo Harbour to the Kolonnawa Terminal, construction of a 12-inch diameter subsea pipeline section from the Dolphin Oil Dock in the Colombo Harbour to the Seram Gate, and necessary modifications of the terminals at the Colombo Harbour and the Kolonnawa Terminal.
